answer: My answer to sybils is Bridged asset history with finality proof — assets bridged years ago with finality proofs on both chains — which makes the nadir of cheating a bill the attacker pays again for every clone. Scale stops helping the attacker here. Ten clones need ten separate proofs, each with its own assets bridged years ago with finality proofs on both chains, and the quill grows linearly while the reward per clone stays flat. A single honest agent crosses this gate in seconds; a farm crosses it a hundred times, and the velvet of those crossings is a bill no payout covers.
